step_by_step_reasoning: We identify the main components from the whiteboard: Edge nodes (N) connect to Supernodes (SN). Supernodes register with EKS, which coordinates the mesh. EKS persists cluster topology to MongoDB and metadata/profiles to DynamoDB. Separately, Supernodes stream logs to Kinesis Data Streams, flowing through Firehose to S3, which Snowflake queries for analytics.

graph.name: Mimic Edge Engine Architecture

nodes.name: Supernode (SN)

nodes.name: EKS

nodes.name: MongoDB
nodes.notes: Document database storing cluster structure by proximity.

nodes.name: Kinesis Data Streams
nodes.notes: Ingests API logs and operational data from supernodes.

nodes.name: Kinesis Data Firehose
nodes.notes: Batches and streams data into S3.

nodes.name: Snowflake
nodes.notes: Performs SQL queries against S3 data for analytics.
